rpc_methods.name: browser_open
rpc_methods.description: Create a task tab, create an unfocused task-owned window, or explicitly adopt the active tab.

rpc_methods.name: browser_snapshot
rpc_methods.description: Read an accessibility snapshot, bounded text or HTML, or a screenshot from a task-owned tab.

rpc_methods.name: browser_act
rpc_methods.description: Run an ordered batch of typed actions against one task-owned tab and page revision.

rpc_methods.name: browser_wait
rpc_methods.description: Wait for one schema-defined load, URL, text, selector, network-idle, or download condition.

rpc_methods.name: browser_tabs
rpc_methods.description: List only tabs owned by this task connection.

rpc_methods.name: browser_handoff
rpc_methods.description: Pause agent actions and give the user control for credentials, MFA, CAPTCHA, or other human-only input.

rpc_methods.name: browser_commit
rpc_methods.description: Execute one previously staged consequential action after semantic review.

rpc_methods.name: browser_developer
rpc_methods.description: Run an explicitly enabled developer-mode action outside the Standard tool surface.

rpc_methods.name: agenttab.status
rpc_methods.description: Read Core readiness without creating or resuming a browser task.
